metrics.deviation: Four reachable cases did not produce a usable archive result within 120 seconds.

metrics.deviation: The run proves nonblank screenshots and records image counts, but has no critical-resource inventory or visual comparison denominator.
metrics.releaseImpact: Blocks a 95 percent completeness claim, but not a restricted internal trial.

metrics.deviation: The offline audit records 167 external attempts but does not retain all local requests, local failures, or a request denominator.
metrics.followUp: Record every file or local-HTTP request and failure, then calculate failures divided by local requests.

metrics.deviation: Structured failures and reports pass unit tests, but the runtime ZIP path does not include the metadata that would make live failures auditable.
metrics.releaseImpact: Blocks the explainability claim until runtime report integration is complete.
metrics.followUp: Package failure manifests and the offline report in every runtime archive, then exercise a controlled failed resource.

metrics.deviation: Cancellation behavior is covered functionally, but no browser test measures click-to-cancelled latency.
metrics.followUp: Add a delayed resource fixture and measure the user-visible cancelled state with a two-second assertion.

metrics.deviation: None of the 18 downloaded runtime archives contains _sitecapsule/report.html.
metrics.releaseImpact: Blocks the MVP release gate and machine-readable delivery claim.
metrics.followUp: Integrate archive, resource, failure, original-URL, report, and offline README entries into runtime packaging.

metrics.releaseImpact: No release impact found by source and production-package inspection.
metrics.followUp: Keep a release-time extension Service Worker network audit as defense in depth.
